title: Objectwise ordinary compact-support coefficient balancing
statement: Fix a prime l and finite extensions E and F of Q_l with a Q_l-algebra map i. For every scheme W and every sheaf M of modules over its completed integral E-coefficient sheaf, extension of the restriction of M along the constant integral E-to-F map is isomorphic to the restriction of completed scalar extension of M. The isomorphism sends every local pure tensor b tensor x to completion(b) tensor x. Only the component isomorphisms and their generator formulas are asserted; naturality and uniqueness are established in the parent.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.2(1), Definition 3.4.10; finite integral-basis construction of the ordinary tensor comparison.

proof.text: Use the sectionwise completed constant-square pushout theorem. Its universal property is the finite-free completed coefficient comparison, normalized by the prescribed constant-to-completion maps.

Apply the sectionwise tensor-balancing construction to the constant map and completed coefficient map. The construction forms the presheaf tensor comparison from the sectionwise pushout, proves restriction compatibility by tensor induction, and transports the comparison through sheafification and the extension-existence identifications. Its generator calculation is exactly the displayed pure-tensor formula.

proof_origin.note: The tensor/sheafification comparison is proved directly by the sectionwise pushout balancing construction; the completed square is split as a strictly smaller statement.
